baseline_invocation_s.source: results/reproduce/out/latest-run/summary.json docking_elapsed_s across all four cases and cpu_standard/gpu_standard/gpu_dense: (9.11+7.28+11.81+11.87)+(1.66+1.38+1.88+1.93)+(16.60+13.88+19.38+19.52)=116.30 s. Estimate complete launch-to-exit invocation as 116.30 * 2 = 232.60 s, adding an explicitly assumed 116.30 s allowance for launch, decoy generation, evaluation, transfers and merge not separately measured. This is a measurement-derived prospective process-wall estimate, not a measured end-to-end duration; adapter smoke must establish real cost. One complete invocation covers all four inputs, all three configurations, deterministic execution seed null.

confidence_rule.decision: Use executable v1 exact binomial order-statistic bounds: one-sided lower bound for paired speedup must exceed 1.05; two-sided equivalence intervals with Bonferroni across four metrics must be contained in declared margins, with exact per-case/per-configuration equality additionally mandatory for deterministic outputs. No significance-only equivalence claim.
confidence_rule.power_basis: Deterministic equivalence exhaustively checks all four fixed inputs, all three configurations and all 50 retained predictions; stochastic power calculation and seed replication not applicable. Seven timing pairs give a finite one-sided 95% median bound (extreme-tail probability 2^-7). Timing variance and power for detecting a 5% gain are unavailable; no powered performance claim is made.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work four-case benchmark with three discrete search configurations and 50 retained poses each; no calibrated outcome-versus-GPU-second curve or scientifically specified scalar DockQ target. Preserve rank-1 and best-of-50 separately. Budgets are allocation caps, not invented quality forecasts.

Baseline summary contains single-run comparative quality and score differences, not seed variability or prespecified numerical tolerances. No tolerance is fitted to those differences. Exact same-configuration preservation does not retrospectively validate CPU/GPU numerical agreement.

Original brief requests CPU/GPU acceleration, numerical agreement and dense-search quality as three separate conclusions. Five-method feasibility menu cannot fully express these comparisons; do not substitute this negative result for their scientific evaluation.
Measured reproduction does not supply complete process wall or billing price. Invocation overhead allowance is explicit assumption, not an observation or guarantee.
No empirical stochastic variation or timing-power calibration available. Any detected randomness, scope change or tolerance change requires a new sealed run.
No additional workloads executed, builds performed, method code written or external evidence consulted during this seal.

paired_seed_tests.justification: MEGADOCK uses fixed documented 3600/54000-angle grids, fixed FFT/scoring settings and deterministic pose generation, not Monte Carlo or random angle sampling (intake/megadock_usage.txt). No random docking seed exists in supplied interface. Execution seed is null. Thread scheduling or floating point differences are correctness failures under this strict preservation protocol, not stochastic scientific sampling.

protocol_cost.arithmetic: (1 warmup + 7 timing pairs) * 2 arms * 232.6 s = 3721.6 s; no outcome-curve budget terms because equal_outcome_target.not_applicable=true.
protocol_cost.status: Skipped under explicit no-feasible-method rule. No performance scorer or method execution authorized by this negative seal; projected full scorer exceeds cap, and no duration was lowered to fit.

scheduling_protocol: For each of seven pairs, randomly choose baseline-first or method-first using fixed scheduling seed 20261102; arms execute serially on identical allocation, no overlapping pairs. Keep case/configuration order fixed as intake/EXECUTION.json. Seeds randomize timing order only, never scientific outputs.

scientific_configuration.fft_points_reason: Published default selects from input dimensions; record actual selected grid, keep identical between CPU/GPU for each case.

splits.reference_policy: Bound native structures used only by evaluator; never for docking or configuration selection.
splits.selection: Fixed four-case PINDER-S pilot from intake/brief.md, indices 3,5,9,15. No new split or selection by observed DockQ. These inputs and their baseline quality results have already been examined; they are not an unseen holdout. No generalization beyond these four systems.

timing_scope.description: Launch to exit of complete four-case invocation: CPU standard, GPU standard and GPU dense; include process launch, input reads, host work, H2D/D2H transfers, kernels, sorting/merge, all 600 decoy generations, DockQ evaluation and reporting. Adapter synchronizes GPU completion. Existing installation and cached inputs fixed for paired timing; separately report acquisition/preparation/build time and total allocation cost if measured. Never substitute sum of kernel timings for process wall.

warmup_protocol: One complete invocation per arm on the same fixed inputs/configurations, discarded from timing inference but charged to allocation. No adaptive warmup. Warmup and all seven measured pairs use complete workloads.
